text:
zoe: heads-up — onboarding `sablev2-int4` canary shows intermittent funcall parse failures when streaming. repro on canary 42.

eva: logs?

zoe: paste from canary: 
```
ERROR: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 204 (char 203)
... \"tool_name\": \"fetch_user\", \"args\": {\"user_id\": \"12345\"}, \"response\": \"{\\\"name\\\": \\\"Alicia\\\", \\\"email\\\": \\\"ali@example.com\\\"}\n```

matt: hmm looks like double-escaping and a truncated string at a chunk boundary. streaming + kv-cache has bitten us before.

kai: quick check — can you reproduce with KV cache disabled?

zoe: yes. with `--kv-cache off` the same prompt returns clean JSON every time. with kv-cache on and long prefix (~1.2k tokens) we occasionally get a trailing backslash at the end of a chunk that breaks the parser.

deploy-bot: Canary 42: new model `sablev2-int4` deployed to canary pool (zone-a).

matt: likely two interacting causes: quantized tokenizer emitting different chunk boundaries, and our chunker not coalescing escapes.

eva: short mitigation: change parser to be tolerant for a single trailing `\\` at end-of-stream buffer — wait up to N ms for more tokens before failing, then attempt join.

zoe: provisional repro command: `./canary_run --model sablev2-int4 --canary-id 42 --kv-cache on --stream-chunk-size 512` (fails ~1/8 runs)

matt: also run mirrored check against fp16: `./canary_run --model sablev2-fp16 --mirror-of 42` to see if quantization is changing tokenization/escape behavior.

kai: i'm starting a mirror run now against fp16, will ping with diffs.

zoe: added a tiny log helper snippet to collect raw chunks: 
```
for chunk in stream:
  write_raw_chunk(chunk)
  attempt_parse(buffer + chunk)
```
This showed chunks ending in `\\` followed by `\"` in next chunk ~40% of failures.

infra-bot: Canary run 42 logs archived: https://redwood.internal/logs/canary/42 (requires SSO)

eva: followups: 1) parser soft-wait for trailing `\\` 2) add canary test with kv-cache on and long prefix 3) run mirror fp16 vs int4 token diffs and post token boundaries.

zoe: created issue RW-1234 linking logs + sample chunks. https://redwood.internal/issue/RW-1234

matt: if we can't ship parser tweak quickly, fallback plan is to disable streaming for int4 canaries or force chunk-size >= 1k.

kai: mirror fp16 confirms fewer boundary splits; raw token diff attached to RW-1234.

zoe: assigning: @matt look at chunker/coalesce logic, @eva add parser guard and unit test, @kai finish mirror comparisons and attach token diffs.

matt: will try a small runtime bump to coalesce any buffer ending in `\\` with next chunk before handing to parser.

zoe: thanks — status update tomorrow EOD. :pray:
